text:
ravi: heads-up i'm going to push a preflight + anneal workflow for runtime.config.route_bias tonight. want the console to offer 'Preflight & Simulate' before any apply. cc @claire @sophie
claire: how do you see the control-plane contract? prefer a single POST that returns a flat validation report and preflight_id for audits.
ravi: yes: POST /api/configs/preflight?simulate=true -> returns report id, diffs, estimated qps/cost deltas, and top-tenants impacted. UI should render a compact card and an approval button.
sophie: telemetry asks: include config.preflight.risk_score metric, sampled traces with header x-rw-preflight-id, and a config.rollout.p95.delta metric. sample_rate=0.5 for WARN/FAIL preflights.
ben: rollout anneal: base steps [5,25,50,100], windows 20m. add adaptive rules: accelerate if risk_score stays low, backoff+pause if p95 delta > 12% for >10m. auto-pause should tag owners and set config state paused_by_telemetry.
ravi: dry_run mode must simulate routing decisions and emit metrics without changing weights. product wants a one-click dry-sim that also spins up a synthetic run for ~10m. ops-bot can kick jobs.
ops-bot: monitorbot: synthetic preflight job queued (job preflight-909). ETA ~7m.
claire: UI should show a preflight summary: risk band, USD/day cost delta, tokens/sec quota delta, top-5 affected customers and a small playbook (pause, pin fallback, rollback). require a comment for approvals for audit.
sophie: also need trace_id -> preflight_id -> config_version mapping in the console to speed investigations. include a helper to fetch traces for a given preflight.
ben: API examples: curl preflight:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/configs/preflight?simulate=true \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"key":"runtime.config.route_bias","value":0.15,"stages":[{"pct":5}]}'
```
claire: debate: should heuristics be declarative (yaml) or code? declarative easier to tune and display; code easier for complex checks. leaning declarative with plugin hooks for special cases.
sophie: agree declarative + sandboxed wasm hooks for customer-specific SLA checks. keeps control plane safe and auditable.
ravi: plan: ship preflight API + minimal console card to internal canaries next week. annealing engine follow-up to allow adaptive steps. i'll post the first preflight_id here once it's live.
ops-bot: deploybot: preflight synthetic started (preflight-909). logs at /infra/jobs/preflight-909/logs
claire: i'll wire the dashboard panels and temporary SLOs for the canary window. will add an auto-created alert that pauses on breach.
ben: also add a rollback shortcut in the card with an example command to force rollback. example rollback: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{"key":"runtime.config.route_bias","value":0.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
sophie: thanks all. this looks solid. once preflight runs i'll review top-customer rows and risk score before we approve.
ravi: thanks team — pushing preview to console now. will wait on synthetic results before applying. :rocket:
